configurations.name: api-auth
runtimeArgs: FEATURE_CONTACT_FORM=true FEATURE_AUTH=true SMTP_HOST=127.0.0.1 AUTH_HMAC_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 48) DATABASE_ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 48) DATABASE_BLIND_INDEX_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 48) JWT_ACCESS_SECRET=$(openssl rand -base64 64 | tr -d '\n') JWT_REFRESH_SECRET=$(openssl rand -base64 64 | tr -d '\n') pnpm --filter @oz/api start

configurations.name: api-documents
runtimeArgs: FEATURE_CONTACT_FORM=true FEATURE_AUTH=true FEATURE_DOCUMENTS=true SMTP_HOST=127.0.0.1 AUTH_HMAC_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 48) DATABASE_ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 48) DATABASE_BLIND_INDEX_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 48) JWT_ACCESS_SECRET=$(openssl rand -base64 64 | tr -d '\n') JWT_REFRESH_SECRET=$(openssl rand -base64 64 | tr -d '\n') pnpm --filter @oz/api start

configurations.name: worker
runtimeArgs: pnpm turbo run build --filter=@oz/worker --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @oz/worker start
